summary:
**RIPPLE** is an interactive 3D space exploration and spacecraft-building game designed to make rocket science fun, accessible, and educational. Players can design their own spacecraft using 103 customizable parts, including engines, solar panels, cameras, and shields. The game features 15 celestial bodies based on real NASA data and 10 space missions across four difficulty levels.

RIPPLE's unique feature is its real-time analysis system, which demonstrates how changes to individual spacecraft components affect weight, fuel, power, heat, and overall performance. Players receive instant safety feedback before launching their rockets into realistic 3D simulations.

The platform also includes a flight failure analysis system, a time-rewind feature for testing alternative designs, and a four-player collaborative mode. Beginner and advanced modes make the experience suitable for different skill levels.

Built using **React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vite**, RIPPLE combines interactive learning, creativity, teamwork, and space exploration into an engaging browser-based experience.
details:
RIPPLE is an interactive 3D spacecraft-building and space exploration game designed to make rocket science accessible, engaging, and educational. Players can build customized spacecraft using 103 different components, explore 15 celestial bodies based on real NASA data, and complete 10 space missions of varying difficulty.

The project's main innovation is its real-time Ripple Analysis System, which demonstrates how modifying one spacecraft component affects other systems, including weight, fuel, power, and heat. Players can identify design flaws through instant safety checks, experience realistic 3D launches, analyze mission failures, and rewind simulations to test alternative solutions. A four-player collaborative mode encourages teamwork and decision-making.

RIPPLE is developed using React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite 8, and a custom physics engine. It runs directly in a web browser without requiring specialized hardware.

Our team prioritized accessibility, educational value, interactive learning, realistic simulations, and user-friendly design. By combining creativity, experimentation, and scientific concepts, RIPPLE aims to inspire curiosity about space exploration while developing problem-solving, critical-thinking, and collaborative skills.
